We are hiring a Chief SAP BI Developer (HANA Modeling) to drive BI, planning, and reporting using SAP HANA modeling, BPC, SAC, and AfO. You will lead BI consultants across Financial Production squads (Plan, Expenses, Reporting) and partner with business and IT stakeholders. You will also own client knowledge transfer and a durable knowledge base.
 Responsibilities
Lead and coach a team of SAP BI consultants, sharing technical direction and best practices
Contribute to technical and functional design across multiple squads (Plan, Expenses, Reporting) within Financial Production
Identify delivery risks, track existing issues, and define an appropriate mitigation plan
Provide expert technical guidance and support development work to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes
Design, configure, and tune SAP BPC to enable planning and consolidation processes
Build and improve SAP Analytics Cloud dashboards and reports to meet business needs
Maintain and optimize SAP Analysis for Office reports, ensuring they align with stakeholder expectations
Ensure integration of BI solutions with SAP S/4HANA and additional data sources as required
Facilitate knowledge transfer from the client team, capturing key processes and best practices
Create and maintain a knowledge database, keeping documentation current and accurate
Optimize performance and improve data accuracy across BI reporting and analytics
Deliver end-user training and provide ongoing support to drive adoption of BI tools
 Requirements
Proven track record with 7+ years of experience delivering SAP BI solutions focused on HANA, BPC, SAC, and AfO
Demonstrated experience leading BI teams and guiding delivery across projects
Deep expertise in SAP BPC (Embedded) for enterprise planning and consolidation
Hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud data modeling, dashboard creation, and predictive analytics
Solid understanding of SAP Analysis for Office and financial/operational reporting practices
Working knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA integration patterns, and data connectivity concepts
Experience running knowledge transfer and producing documentation that enables smooth team transitions
Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot, decide, and resolve complex issues
Excellent stakeholder management abilities with clear, effective communication
English proficiency at B2 level or higher
 Nice to have
SAP BPC or SAC certification
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA and HANA modeling
Knowledge of scripting and automation in SAC or BPC
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management best practices
